game_title: Length Limit – Fallen Statue Garden Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the spirit seeker must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Length Limit: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Fallen Statue Garden.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: In Fallen Statue Garden, repeat each round: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Fallen Statue Garden. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the capacity value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about capacity to power up the spirit seeker and open the ancient lock.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 5 (applied tier): Length Limit
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how capacity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
